reviewer: Codex implementation self-review; independent human approval required
rationale: The cumulative change is no longer an opaque oversized batch. Seven dependency-ordered PRs are individually reviewable, template-complete, free of pnpm-lock.yaml changes, mergeable, and at 5/5 automated review with no unresolved threads. The final Conversation review also confirmed that late request disconnects cancel the runtime after callback installation. The master-based first PR has a green complete remote workflow. Local typecheck, build, focused Conversation regression, browser acceptance, token, bundle, brand, and diff gates pass. The remaining constraint is procedural rather than hidden: PRs 3-8 do not receive the full workflow while based on another stack branch, so each must be retargeted and reach green CI before its own merge.
conditions: After each parent merges, retarget the next PR to master and require its complete remote workflow to pass before merging it.
Recheck mergeability, current-head automated review, and unresolved threads immediately before each merge.
A human reviewer must approve each PR; this advisory review does not authorize merge, deployment, release, or shipping.
